summary: The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies comprising the BITA Crypto Assets & Digital Payments Index. The index is a rules-based composite index that tracks the market performance of 25 companies, listed on regulated exchanges based in the U.S., that are actively engaged in crypto-related activities. The fund is non-diversified.
